leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl.

==Volume releases==
Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl was divided into four sets that were released by and Shogakukan from 2007 to 2011. It contains almost all the 191 episodes between them, except Satoshi and Hikari! Facing a New Adventure!! (a clip show summarizing the series' first year) and selected episodes that were released separately. All the DVDs were released for rental only.

===Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl===
Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2007. It consists of 19 volumes with 56 episodes across them combined.

The Strongest Koiking and the Most Beautiful Hinbass! and Beadaru Knew! were released separately. The former is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Naughty Island, and the latter is included on a DVD along with Pikachu's Exploration Club.

The first Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl clip show, Satoshi and Hikari! Facing a New Adventure!!, was not released on DVD.

 

===Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2008===
Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2008 was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2008. It consists of 15 volumes with 44 episodes across them combined.

Pokémon Ranger! The Wave-Guiding Riolu!! (Part 1) and Pokémon Ranger! The Wave-Guiding Riolu!! (Part 2) were released separately.

 

===Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2009===
Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2009 was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2009. It consists of 15 volumes with 44 episodes across them combined.

Pikachu-Pochama Drifting Chronicle! was released separately. It is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Ice Adventure.

 

===Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2010===
Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl 2010 was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2010. It consists of 14 volumes with 40 episodes across them combined and it concludes Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl.

Pokémon Ranger! Heatran Rescue Mission!! was released separately. It is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Sparkle Search!.

 

==Special releases==
Some episodes of Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl were released by and Shogakukan as part of a special set.

 

==External links==
Dogasu's Backpack - TV Episodes DVD Guide (Region 2)
